research_findings: Waitlist signup endpoint lacked rate-limiting, making it vulnerable to abuse.
Identified that server actions can access IP via next/headers x-forwarded-for.
Since serverless environment limits shared state, an in-memory limit handles instance-level protection adequately.
next_steps_for_next_run: Implement Redis-backed shared rate-limiting if app scales beyond single-instance deployments.
Explore applying rate limit util to other vulnerable endpoints (e.g., auth actions).
